invariants.description: Delta_Ts = sigma_Ts (1 - exp(-t/tau_Ts)), sigma_Ts = G_Ts ln(f_s - f_es_min + 1) above threshold
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Delta_Ts - (G_Ts*np.log(f_s - f_es_min + 1) if f_s >= f_es_min else 0.0)*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_Ts)))) <= 1e-5*max(1e-3, abs(G_Ts)*5)

bc_sweep.rationale: sympathetic from silent to f_es_max; vagal 0-15 spikes/s (Ursino range f_ev,0 3.2 to f_ev,inf 6.3 plus chemoreceptor contribution); gains/time constants 0.5-2x.

baseline.reason: Candidate: heart-period response to vagal/sympathetic stimulation (e.g. the VNS heart-rate data shipped with the Gee2023 BioModels entry, Rajendran 2019 pig data) - needs a network with a heart; not set up.
